target_customer: Merchants in dense settings such as campuses and gyms, with consumers paying by fingerprint (as piloted in 2013); the YC directory text instead describes freelancers sending invoices
problem: Paying with cards and phones is slower than it could be; PayTango let customers pay by touching a fingerprint scanner linked to a card.
business_model: Undecided in 2013, possibly a monthly subscription to merchants

founders.name: Umang Patel
founders.background_notes: Listed as sole founder on YC page; a TechCrunch article lists four recent Carnegie Mellon graduates.

technical_complexity.rationale: Required custom fingerprint reader hardware that emits card compatible data into existing point of sale systems, plus payments integration, for a team of recent graduates.

defensibility.rationale: No patents or network effects were found; adoption depended on enrolling users at each location, which gives local lock in only if it scaled.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found; the company went inactive and no acquirer is recorded.

market_need_then: In March 2013 TechCrunch framed fingerprint payment as an alternative to cards, phones and QR codes. A pilot with Carnegie Mellon students existed, but no spend or demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: paytango.com now redirects to an unrelated site, so the original domain was lost.

brand_strength.rationale: Only one press piece on the company and no brand assets or community found.

pivots.why: Not stated; the YC directory text and the 2013 press describe different products, so the order is uncertain.

outcome_analysis: PayTango is listed as inactive and the cause is not public: no shutdown note, post-mortem or acquisition was found. The YC directory describes invoicing while 2013 press describes a fingerprint payment terminal, so the product story is unclear. Hardware and merchant adoption are plausible hurdles but are not sourced, so no failure factor is assigned.
notes: Cause of inactivity not found. Crunchbase snippet tags a seed round with no amount; unverified so no round recorded. The original website redirects to an unrelated domain and was not followed. Competitor search found no dated sources, and the TechCrunch piece names none. Founders: YC page lists only Umang Patel; TechCrunch names four.
